phrases.text: Stop hunting Pirate Shop Access solo. Here's why!
If anyone in your squad finds it in a chest, every member of the squad gets it.
No friends online? Hit Fill. Four players means four times the chests.
And every chest counts: normal, rare, Sprite, buried, Wanted Poster, even Relic chests.
Who are you teaming up with tonight?
Use code BAD in the Item Shop. It really helps the channel.
Thank you for watching! Follow for more daily content.
